The '''Audience Hall''' was a building located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It was connected to the [[High Priest House]], the [[Priest House]], and the [[House of War]]. The Hall had a central chamber that could hold a large number of [[Sedrian]]s. [[High Priest]] [[Cardo (Sedrian)|Cardo]] received visitors in the Audience Hall as well as hearing petitions from Sedrian citizens.<ref name="BGS" />
